device.name: Xiaomi Mijia LYWSD03MMC Thermometer/Hygrometer
device.notes:
Compact BLE thermometer and hygrometer with E-ink display. Telink TLSR8251 SoC, CR2032 battery, 6-12 month battery life. $4-6. 6 hardware versions: B1.4, B1.5, B1.6, B1.7, B1.9, B2.0.
STOCK FIRMWARE: broadcasts Xiaomi MiBeacon format (service UUID 0xFE95) with encrypted payload. Requires Xiaomi cloud account and Mi Home app to decrypt. The encryption bindkey can be extracted from the Mi Home app for use with third-party integrations.
CUSTOM FIRMWARE (recommended for local control): the pvvx/ATC_MiThermometer project provides OTA-flashable firmware (via web browser at https://pvvx.github.io/ATC_MiThermometer/TelinkMiFlasher.html) that:
  - Broadcasts unencrypted temperature/humidity/battery
  - Supports 4 advertisement formats: ATC, Xiaomi, Custom, BTHome v2
  - Has configurable advertising interval and TX power
  - Provides GATT connection mode for configuration
  - Supports encrypted beacons with PIN-code or bindkey
  - Exposes standard Device Information (0x180A) and Battery (0x180F) services
  - Supports BLE 5.0+ LE Long Range (Coded PHY S=8)

UNENCRYPTED ATC (atc1441) ADVERTISEMENT FORMAT — Service Data UUID 0x181A:
  bytes 0-5: MAC (big-endian)
  bytes 6-7: temperature int16 BE, ×0.1 °C
  byte 8: humidity %
  byte 9: battery %
  bytes 10-11: battery mV (uint16 BE)
  byte 12: advertisement counter

UNENCRYPTED PVVX CUSTOM ADVERTISEMENT FORMAT — same 0x181A UUID, 13-14 B:
  bytes 0-5: MAC
  bytes 6-7: temperature int16 LE, ×0.01 °C
  bytes 8-9: humidity uint16 LE, ×0.01 %
  bytes 10-11: battery mV (uint16)
  byte 12: battery %
  byte 13: advertisement counter
  byte 14: trigger/status flags
(custom_beacon.h adv_atc1441_t / adv_custom_t)
ENCRYPTED ATC/Custom BEACONS: AES-CCM with bindkey, nonce = MAC+header(5 bytes), auth data = 0x11, MAC len = 4. The decrypted plaintexts are the compact 3-byte (temp=(v/2)-40 °C, hum=v/2 %, battery bits 6-0 + trigger bit 7) and 6-byte (temp int16 LE 0.01 °C, humi uint16 LE 0.01 %, battery %, flags) layouts in payload_formats below — those two layouts do NOT appear on the air unencrypted.
GATT CONNECTION (custom firmware): device advertises as "ATC_XXXXXX" (where XXXXXX are last 3 bytes of MAC). Standard services:
  0x180A — Device Information (manufacturer, model, firmware version)
  0x180F — Battery Service (battery level)
Configuration is done via proprietary characteristics on the ATC service. Set defaults command: write 0x56, disable Long Range: write 0xDD.
ALSO SUPPORTS: MHO-C401/C401N, MJWSD05MMC, Qingping CGG1-M/CGDK2, Tuya TH03/ZTH01/02/05 — all with same custom firmware and Telink SoC.
CURRENT STATUS (verified 2026-07-31): custom firmware v5.8 defaults to the BTHome v2 advertisement format. The same hardware converts to Zigbee via pvvx/ZigbeeTLc (Z03MMC). Units sold since 2025-03 with PCB marks B1.5*/B1.6* use SPI LCD controllers and cheaper clone sensors, drawing more current with a low-contrast display — pvvx currently advises against buying LYWSD03MMC (ATC_MiThermometer issue #664).
STOCK FIRMWARE DISCOVERY: name "LYWSD03MMC", service UUID 0xFE95 (MiBeacon). Data is encrypted; decryption requires bindkey obtained from Xiaomi cloud or the Mi Home app.
MI HOME APP EVIDENCE (jadx decompile audit, 2026-08): the app contains NO device-specific code for this model — Mi Home device plugins are downloaded from Xiaomi's cloud at pairing time, and "LYWSD03MMC" is entirely absent from the decompiled app (sources and bundled assets), so the app can only corroborate generic Xiaomi mechanisms, nothing model-specific. What it does confirm:
  - MiBeacon service UUID 0xFE95 and the frame-control layout: bytes
    0-1 are a little-endian frame-control field (bit 3 = payload
    encrypted, plus capability/MAC/event/binding flag bits) and the
    version sits in the high nibble of byte 1
    (miui/bluetooth/ble/MiServiceData.java).
  - During provisioning the app pushes the cloud-issued bindkey to
    the device via a miio RPC with method "set_bind_key" (params
    carry bind_key plus Wi-Fi credentials)
    (smartconfig/step/BindKeyStep.java).
  - The bundled device catalog (assets/device_config/plugin_config_us-en)
    lists MiOT model "miaomiaoce.sensor_ht.t2" (pd_id 1371, "Mi
    Temperature and Humidity Monitor 2" — this device's retail name),
    its Mi Home/MiOT identity; no plugin or logic for it ships in the
    app itself.
CONFIDENCE for the app-evidence block: MEDIUM — app-derived, not verified on hardware.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH for custom firmware advertisement formats, service UUIDs, and GATT services — sourced from github.com/pvvx/ATC_MiThermometer and confirmed by Home Assistant Passive BLE Monitor, BTHome, and other integrations. Stock firmware MiBeacon format documented by Xiaomi but encrypted payload requires cloud-derived bindkey. Firmware is OTA-flashable and reversible.

ATC_3byte.description: 3-byte ATC layout. NOTE: this compact layout exists only as the AES-CCM PLAINTEXT of the ENCRYPTED ATC beacon (adv_atc_data_t in custom_beacon.h) — it never appears on the air unencrypted. The unencrypted on-air ATC format is ATC_atc1441 below.

ATC_atc1441.description: Unencrypted on-air ATC advertisement (adv_atc1441_t in custom_beacon.h), Service Data 0x181A.

Custom_unencrypted.description: Unencrypted on-air Custom (pvvx) advertisement (adv_custom_t in custom_beacon.h), Service Data 0x181A, 14 bytes.

fields.description: Advertisement counter; a flags byte follows on 15-byte frames.
fields.name: counter

PVVX_6byte.description: 6-byte Custom layout. NOTE: as with ATC_3byte, this is the AES-CCM PLAINTEXT of the ENCRYPTED Custom beacon (adv_cust_data_t in custom_beacon.h) — the unencrypted on-air Custom format is Custom_unencrypted below.

issued_to_client: Bindkey (stock firmware, obtained from Xiaomi cloud)
credentials.notes: Custom firmware stores no cloud credentials. Optional PIN for GATT access control.

factory_reset.effect: Clears bindkey, PIN, comfort settings, and measurement history. Returns to custom firmware defaults.

steps.action: Connect to ATC_XXXXXX device via GATT.
Remove CR2032 battery for 10+ seconds, then reinsert.

methods.description: Flash custom firmware via web browser OTA to enable direct unencrypted BLE advertisement of temperature, humidity, and battery without Xiaomi cloud dependency.

steps.action: Click 'Connect' and select LYWSD03MMC from the browser BLE chooser.
Click 'Do Activation' to extract decryption key.

steps.expect: Device reboots and advertises as ATC_XXXXXX.

cloud.local_alternative: Flash custom firmware for fully local control.

methods.description: Alternative: pair with Xiaomi Mi Home app to obtain bindkey, then use stock firmware with encrypted MiBeacon decryption.

setup.notes:
STOCK FIRMWARE requires Xiaomi cloud account and Mi Home app for initial pairing and bindkey extraction. CUSTOM FIRMWARE eliminates this requirement — flash via web browser OTA from https://pvvx.github.io/ATC_MiThermometer/TelinkMiFlasher.html (Chrome/Edge/Opera with Experimental Web Platform features enabled). Firmware change is reversible (original firmware images available). After flashing, device advertises as "ATC_XXXXXX" with unencrypted data.
Battery must be >40% for reliable OTA flashing on LYWSD03MMC.
LOCKDOWN CAVEAT: devices shipping stock firmware 2.1.1_0159 require Mi Home registration plus an extracted Mi token/bindkey (e.g. via Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor) before the TelinkMiFlasher OTA works — the unauthenticated stock OTA was closed by Xiaomi, so the cloud-free flashing path no longer holds for recent stock (ATC_MiThermometer issue #602).

rejoin.notes: Custom firmware: scan for ATC_XXXXXX. Stock: requires Mi Home re-pairing.

services.name: Environmental Sensing Service
services.notes: Used in advertisement Service Data for ATC custom firmware beacon broadcasts, AND exposed as a real GATT service by the custom firmware (app_att.c): Temperature 0x2A6E and Humidity 0x2A6F, both read + notify. Data is therefore available either from passive BLE scanning of the advertisement payload or over a GATT connection.

services.name: Device Information Service
services.notes: Standard BLE Device Information. Exposed by custom firmware v1.5+ when connected via GATT. Provides manufacturer name, model number, serial number, firmware revision, hardware revision, and software revision.

services.name: Battery Service
services.notes: Standard BLE Battery Service. Exposed by custom firmware.
